verdict.rationale: Google Drive's own API documents push notifications. An application can watch resources and is notified whenever a watched resource changes, and a changes resource represents each change to a file or shared drive. This is a first-party, programmatic event-subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering an HTTPS callback URL, notification payload format, channel lifetime and renewal details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: The Google Drive API provides push notifications that let you monitor changes in resources.
Whenever a watched resource changes, the Google Drive API notifies your application.
Google Drive API provides push notifications that let you watch for changes to resources.
A change to a file or shared drive.
